params.body:
Fixes bevinding een-blur-fout-zei-niet-wat-er-terugkwam. Nightwatch #37.

A `ProcessImage` job failed for a dealer at 14:33 today and the whole message was:

```
Blur error:
```

`BluritService` threw `'... error: ' . $response->json()` in four places. `json()` returns an array,
so at best the message read "Blur error: Array"; when the answer was not JSON it returned null and
the message was that bare prefix. No status code, no body, nothing to go on. The photo stays
unprocessed and the only way to learn anything is a trip to production.

All four now carry the status and a readable piece of what came back, through one small helper. Same
treatment as the Nederland Mobiel answer earlier today, for the same reason: an error that throws the
evidence away is worse than no error.

The tests fake a refusal and an empty answer; both fail against the service on main, the first on
"de statuscode hoort erin".

**Noted, not changed:** these calls carry no timeout of their own. The failing job took six seconds
and Laravel's default is thirty, so a silent Blurit would hold a queue worker for half a minute per
photo. That is a separate call and it is written into the finding rather than folded in here.
params.title: A blur error says what came back
